_meta.description: Chip placements that cannot be moved by the packer. Positions are board-local mm coords (relative to the tile's centre). Mating-pad refs (those starting with 'P_') anchor at (0,0) automatically and are listed here only when they need explicit rotation or face. Future scope: locked trace segments (smash doesn't model traces yet).

U_HACC.reason: H3LIS331 ±400g high-G accel: deliberately offset 1.0/1.0 mm (= 1.41 mm radius) from the spin axis so its centripetal term a = ω²r is a usable, non-zero spin-rate readout (≈20 g at 60 Hz, ≈228 g at 200 Hz) — the only roll/ω sensor that survives both spin rates, since the ISM330 gyro saturates (>4000 dps) and the IIS2MDC mag is sub-Nyquist at 200 Hz. The 1.41 mm radius is small enough to stay inside ±400 g even at 200 Hz worst case and to dominate the unspecified intrinsic MEMS proof-mass offset (DS9012 does not give it), yet keeps the axial rapid-deceleration reading clean (centripetal lands on X/Y; <5% cross-axis bleed is negligible vs the rapid deceleration). Characterise r_eff empirically (spin at known ω → r_eff=√(a/ω²)). Moved to fin_ble_board's TOP face 2026-11-17 (user: activation_interface's top too busy) at the same 1.41 mm offset — fin_ble's bottom centre is U_G0B1_FIN; the axial readings don't care which board. UPDATE 2026-11-16: the 1.41 mm offset saturates ±400 g above ≈16,000 rpm (≈14,000 rpm → ≈310 g OK; 50,200 rpm saturates X/Y at ANY achievable radius — r would have to be ≤0.14 mm). High-spin rate/roll therefore comes from a dedicated fast AMR/TMR turn-counting magnetometer (user decision, part TBD); the H3LIS stays for axial >16 g (drag, ejection, parachute opening) and as the low-spin ω cross-check.

U_PMIC.reason: Sjoert's final routed power_board (WIP/Sjoert/power_board_generated, 2026-09-28) — locked so the wakeup/companion spacer cavities and LGA fields are cut against the board as routed, not the packer's layout

U_MPU.reason: VFBGA-361 (10x10 mm body, 12x12 courtyard). Hand-placed + locked at (-7.7, 2.7) KiCad-frame, SW of the disc; Y negated for the math-Y-up placement frame. Rotation 0 deg per the ST AN5724 STM32MP25xxAK reference. Diagonal with U_DDR4 (NE) so the pair clears the NW/SE potting holes and leaves the centre/south of the top face for the SPI-NAND + DDR decoupling. (2026-11-20, user: the whole compute layout turned 180° about the centre — U_NAND_B sat on the potting hole, which stays on the main potting axis; MPU/DDR4/NAND keep their relative geometry.)

U_DDR4.reason: SMARTsemi KTDM4G4B626BGIEAT DDR4 (FBGA-96 7.5x13, courtyard 9.6x15.1). Hand-placed + locked at (6.9, -2.3) KiCad-frame, NE of the 34 mm disc; un-rotated (0 deg) per the STM32MP2 DDR4 reference (was 270 deg DDR3L). Diagonal with U_MPU (SW): the un-rotated 15.1 mm-tall courtyard sits between the NW/SE potting holes (radius 14, 135/315 deg), clearing both, and leaves the centre/south of the top face for the two SPI-NAND dies. Refdes renamed U_DDR3 -> U_DDR4 in the DDR3->DDR4 swap. (2026-11-20, user: the whole compute layout turned 180° about the centre — U_NAND_B sat on the potting hole, which stays on the main potting axis; MPU/DDR4/NAND keep their relative geometry.)

ANT_NFC.reason: The Ø22 round NFC coil IS the whole nfc_antenna_flex tile — centre it. Locked because the packer's square-bbox fit test rejects a full-disc circular footprint inside a circular tile (bbox corners exceed the radius) even though the round coil fits the round tile fine.

P_CELL_TAB_POS.reason: Single-cell (+) SIDE SOLDER-TAB land on activation_interface's BOTTOM face (2026-11-15 aft reorder; was aft_end_board's top) at the NORTH cell end (0, +13.9). The cell is laid straight N–S (vertical in plan), so its side tabs bend down at the Y-axis bore ends. + -> BAT_RAW (no iso R — single cell). Cells are ordered with factory-welded side tabs, NOT end pins (2026-07-30) — the flat cell bottom rests on the aft floor. Real tab-land footprint TBD. (Swap with NEG if the physical cell's + end is South.)

P_CELL_TAB_NEG.reason: Single-cell (−) SIDE SOLDER-TAB land on activation_interface's BOTTOM face (2026-11-15 aft reorder; was aft_end_board's top) at the SOUTH cell end (0, −13.9), 180° opposite P_CELL_TAB_POS on the vertical N–S cell axis. - -> GND. Side tabs, not end pins (2026-07-30). Real tab-land footprint TBD.
